content: InstancedMesh raycasting returns instanceId on intersection, letting you identify which instance was hit. But raycasting InstancedMesh gives no raycast performance benefit over individual meshes (still tests every triangle of every instance) — InstancedMesh's benefit is purely draw-call/render performance, not raycast performance. Rule of thumb: use InstancedMesh when instance count is large (tens to hundreds+) and instances share geometry/material (e.g. many small asteroids); use individual Mesh objects when count is small (dozens) or each object needs independent per-object behavior/animation/distinct raycast enable-disable. For a solar-system asteroid belt with a few dozen NeoWs objects, individual meshes are simpler and sufficient; InstancedMesh becomes worthwhile only if rendering hundreds+ of decorative background asteroids.
